settings.text_2: Our Premium Fleece Hoodie is an embodiment of oversized comfort & style. Made with 100% skin-friendly materials. This breathable fleece will keep you cozy all year round. Its ultra-soft oversized fit wraps you in warmth like a blanket.

settings.heading: Material & Care
settings.content:
100% Hypoallergenic Premium-Grade Polyester

Machine wash cold, tumble dry on low heat, and avoid ironing or using fabric softeners to maintain the softness and coziness of your blanket for years to come.

settings.heading: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Shipping

All Orders are fulfilled and then shipped to anywhere in 1-3 working days on average.

Worldwide shipping (other than US) takes 4-8 working days depending on location:

  • United States: 1-3 days
  • Europe: 4-8 days
  • Australia: 4-8 days
  • United Kingdom: 4-8 days
  • Canada: 4-8 days
  • Rest of world: 4-8 days

All orders come with tracking information once shipped.

Returns

Not happy with your purchase? No worries, we've got you covered!

You may return it within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange, no questions asked. To initiate a return, just contact our customer service team at support@thefleeceblanket.com.

settings.title: Here’s Why Our Fleece Blankets Are the Best

settings.text:
Crafted from luxuriously soft fleece that’s so cozy even clouds would be envious. The fluffy texture is breathable to keep you cool while staying snug, and it’s pet-friendly—perfect for hiding your furry friend’s hair.

Experience ultimate comfort with a blanket designed for both you and your pets!
Our oversized fleece blankets are designed to fit in a standard washing machine, making it easy to keep them clean and cozy. Just toss it in, wash, tumbler and you’re good to go.
We won’t rest until you're completely happy and unbelievably cozy in your Fleece Blanket.
